scientific_integrity: The Poisson marking and first-renewal formula are classical; the new claim is the uniquely classified discontinuous optimum under a fixed sum of flip and reset rates. Potential implications of broader first-passage work remain a stated priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric velocities, exponential event times, initially target-facing orientation, zero-duration complete relaunch, one half-line target, and a fixed combined decision-event intensity. Only mean first-passage-time optimization is established; independent audit not performed.
title: A first-order optimal-search switch in switching-event telegraph resetting
